name: browser-automation-studio.find-flows
purpose: Rank persisted BAS workflows, scenario-owned bas/ assets, and search-hub workflow hits against a task with a deterministic fit label; one ai.classify call only to break a tie at the k boundary.

task.description: The browser task in plain words.

scenario.description: Scenario whose bas/ assets workflow-health should search; without it that source is skipped.

assumptions: browser-automation-studio and workflow-health are running; a stopped owner marks its own source unavailable rather than emptying the candidate list
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
at most k candidates are returned; no row set above 100 is materialized
ai.classify runs at most once, and only to break a tie at the k boundary
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
No memory I/O: this is an S3 step; the usage skill owns recall and capture in bas-usage.

bindings.note: Called with rows="ranked" (the response has four repeated fields).

signals.candidates: up to k of {source, id, name, folder, overlap, fit(strong|weak), runnable_by_id, mutating?, leaf_type?, ai?} sorted by overlap desc
signals.sources: row counts per source: workflows_list, workflow_health (null when no scenario was given), search_hub; null when that source failed
